title: Best of Downtown Los Angeles by Luxury E-Bike
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: From exquisite mosaics and art deco design at the Federal Building and Union Station to historical artifacts at Ávila Adobe, the oldest residence in the city of Los Angeles. From the largest art colony in the world to gritty graffiti back alleys, pop up flea markets and the monumental helical bike ramp of the Sixth Street Viaduct. Immerse yourself in the colorful cacophony of the Fashion District, the Piñata District and Santee Alley then get some calm 'helmet time' amidst Elysian Park's wide, palm lined trails with sweeping views of Dodger Stadium and the San Gabriel Mountains. We’ll hit four DIstricts (Arts, Fashion, Piñata and Brewery) three Parks (Glassell, Cypress and Elysian) three Towns (Chinatown, Dogtown, Frogtown) plus Lincoln Heights and Atwater Village. Let's Ride!
